items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith (and Dontayvion Wicks) for Monday Night vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth thin; more targets to remaining pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Dallas Goedert TE1 upside spikes; A.J. Brown volume if applicable.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) downgraded to OUT for Week 7 vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley to start again. Third straight miss.
items.why: High ankle sprain; practiced but ruled out Saturday.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for Flowers/Andrews/Likely in pass game.

items.text: Sunday injuries dump: Q - Lamar/Puka/Breece/Mayfield/Dowdle/Mason/Kirk/Dell/Coleman etc. OUT - Evans/Deebo/Adams/Rice/Love/Montgomery/Egbuka/Warren/Charbonnet/BRob. IN - Jacobs/Judkins/Addison/Hockenson/Bateman/Tucker etc.
items.implication: Massive role changes; monitor Qs for final.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries for OUTs (e.g. Bijan for BRob, Kittle/CMC for SF WRs, etc.); reverse if INs unexpected.

items.text: Puka Nacua (calf) questionable/GTD; will test pregame. If out, Stafford hierarchy: Higbee, Mumpfield, Parkinson, Atwell, Whittington, Allen.
items.why: Calf; majority Thursday practice but felt lack of power/explosion; no Friday practice. McVay: pregame test.
items.implication: Major slate swing; Rams WR corps already thin (Adams out).
items.opportunity: If OUT, Higbee lead TE/WR funnel; Mumpfield WR3 upside.

items.text: Activated/expected: Tank Dell (Texans debut ~2yrs), Christian Kirk (49ers debut), Jordan Mason (Vikings), Jonah Coleman (Broncos).
items.implication: Immediate roles; Dell/Kirk depth adds, Mason RB committee.
items.opportunity: Kirk SF WR targets amid injuries; Mason flex upside.

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs from exempt list; expected to play Sunday at Detroit.
items.implication: Returns after layoff; workload TBD but starter.
items.opportunity: RB2/flex with goal-line work; monitor snaps post-layoff.

items.text: Saquon Barkley questionable but expected to play vs Cowboys Monday; if active, right back in fantasy lineups. Efficient in prior full games; Dallas soft vs RBs.
items.implication: RB1 if active vs plus matchup.
items.opportunity: Full workload return; start if cleared.

items.text: Breece Hall Q; Stephania worried on immediate return but Berry starts him if plays vs Miami.
items.why: Quad; if active vs soft D, start.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK with Caleb: 30% TS, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec/60+ yds both games. Also loves A.J. Brown usage.
items.why: Post-Caleb return usage spike; Bears good for yardage.

items.text: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) OUT. 49ers D inflating opposing RB production (4.4% over baseline, 7th-most); recent RB catches high. Sweet setup for Bijan Robinson.
items.why: BRob OUT + SF DvP data showing RB inflation (White, Holani, Harvey, Love recent).
items.implication: Bijan full workload + receiving upside vs soft D.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/targets/red-zone for Bijan; start with confidence.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts: scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans etc). CMC may line up more slot amid WR injuries (tempted despite usual fade of RB-as-WR).
items.why: WR injuries funnel to TE/RB; CMC smile on slot comment.
items.implication: Kittle elite TE1; CMC receiving boost.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets/red-zone for Kittle; slot snaps CMC.

items.text: Luther Burden elite 2.56 YPRR on only 68.8% routes; Kmet injury may reduce 2/3-sets for more juice. TreVeyon Henderson just 21% snaps last 3 weeks - downgrade.
items.why: Efficiency + potential route increase; Henderson snap share crash.
items.opportunity: Burden more routes/targets; Henderson limited role.

items.text: Loves: Tucker Kraft (@DET TE boost, Lions allow TE TDs), Jaylen Warren (@NO big workload vs soft RB D), Chuba Hubbard (vs TB consistent), Bucky Irving (@CAR).
items.why: Workloads + matchups (Lions TE buffet; RB-friendly Ds).

items.text: Hates: Rome Odunze (vs NE/Gonzalez shadow), Josh Downs (target share/low-scoring), Travis Kelce (tough matchup), Josh Jacobs (post-layoff workload Q).
items.conflict: Jacobs now activated/expected; monitor actual snaps vs hate.
